plan_title: Restore topo-respect to compute-schedule (no-op recompute removal)
_batching_rationale: TASK-001 ships a pure-addition shared helper (plan_ops.py + tests/scripts/test_plan_ops.py) and unblocks TASK-002 + TASK-003. TASK-002 and TASK-003 both lock plan_ops.py + tests/scripts/test_plan_ops.py, so they cannot co-batch — they serialize after TASK-001. TASK-005 also locks plan_ops.py + tests/scripts/test_plan_ops.py and is independent of the helper, so it serializes alongside the TASK-002/003 chain (the dep-aware batcher places it on its own layer). TASK-004 touches SKILL.md + dispatch-templates.md + plan_ops_cheatsheet.md + a brand-new test file (no plan_ops.py / test_plan_ops.py overlap), so it co-batches freely after TASK-002 + TASK-003. TASK-006 locks plan_ops.py + test_plan_ops.py and depends on TASK-002 + TASK-003, so it lands last on the plan_ops.py chain.

chunks.origin_note: Path C (canonicalize). Pure-addition helper extraction; no behavior change in isolation. Unblocks TASK-002 (compute-schedule wiring) and TASK-003 (build-tasks wiring). The helper consolidates the two batchers' overlapping logic into a single source of truth for topo + file-disjoint + global-lock placement, which is the structural prerequisite for declaring the SKILL.md recompute a provable no-op.

Load-bearing fix. Replaces _compute_schedule_batches's broken file-disjoint-only packer with a delegation to TASK-001's helper, adds dependencies[] shape validation, and rewrites the test that pins the bug (test_disjoint_files_single_batch). After this task lands, the compute-schedule --stdin CLI returns topo-respecting batches for every caller — including the orchestrator's Phase 1 step 3 pipe (until TASK-004 deletes that pipe entirely).

Eliminates duplicate batching logic inside _build_tasks by routing it through TASK-001's helper. Side-benefit: build-tasks gains global-lock solitary placement (which it previously omitted), aligning it with compute-schedule. Adds the idempotence test (build-tasks output == compute-schedule output) that authorizes TASK-004's SKILL.md deletion.

Deletes the no-op compute-schedule --stdin recompute from SKILL.md Phase 1 step 3 (default + --task-ids filter branches), updates dispatch-templates.md and plan_ops_cheatsheet.md, and adds a fence test that fails if the recompute is ever re-introduced. Depends on TASK-002 + TASK-003 because the deletion is only safe once both batchers route through the same helper (idempotence is provable).

Removes the write-only parallel_batches field from _decompose_plan emission and from all live (non-archive) 00_INDEX.json rosters + fixtures + tests. Adds a back-compat parse test pinning that old rosters carrying the field continue to parse. Independent of the topo fix proper; bundled here as adjacent cleanup that reduces operator confusion between roster parallel_batches and schedule batches[].

Defense-in-depth. Adds dependency-batch-violation error to _validate_schedule_dag so any persisted schedule whose batches violate task deps fails parse-schedule / write-schedule / schedule-valid gate. Catches what Codex plan-review already catches at LLM level, but earlier and deterministically. Depends on TASK-002 + TASK-003 because tightening the validator before both batchers are fixed would fail the existing test fixtures.
